'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Josh LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Username:''' Renmaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
